name: Mattermost GLPI Plugin
description: GLPI IT support inside Mattermost: tickets, follow-ups, attachments, assets, knowledge base, and notifications.

settings_schema.header: Configure the connection to your GLPI instance. Generate the App Token under Setup > General > API and the User Token under the API user's preferences in GLPI.

settings.help_text: The base URL of your GLPI instance, for example https://glpi.example.com.
The GLPI application token used for authentication.
The GLPI user token used for authentication.
Numeric GLPI entity ID used when creating tickets. Leave empty to use the API user's default entity.
Numeric GLPI ITIL category ID applied to new tickets when the user does not choose one.
Channel ID where GLPI webhook notifications are posted. Leave empty to disable channel notifications.
Shared secret for the GLPI webhook endpoint. Configure GLPI to POST to <site-url>/plugins/com.ntas.glpi/webhook with the X-GLPI-Secret header set to this value.
Enable additional debug logging for troubleshooting.
Maximum allowed file upload size in bytes. Default: 10485760 (10 MB).
Comma-separated list of allowed MIME types for file uploads. Example: image/jpeg,image/png,application/pdf. Leave empty to use the default set.
Maximum requests per second to the GLPI API. Default: 5.
Timeout for GLPI API requests in seconds. Default: 10.
Time window in seconds during which duplicate webhook deliveries are detected and dropped. Default: 86400 (24 hours).
Number of worker goroutines processing the retry queue. Default: 1.
Maximum number of retry attempts for failed operations. Default: 5.
Base backoff interval in seconds for retry queue exponential backoff. Default: 2.
